title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.
  
  
Konovo provides healthcare organisations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms.
  
  
As we transition from a service-oriented model to a product-driven platform, we are expanding our hybrid Bengaluru-based team. As Senior Talent Partner, you will play a critical role in building the talent density that fuels our company's growth. We believe great companies are built by great people, and you will serve as a culture champion who helps business leaders meet ambitious business outcomes by building exceptional teams.
  
  
This is a hybrid role based out of Whitefield, Bengaluru. You will work UK hours (approximately 2:00-11:00pm IST) with occasional flexibility required to support business needs.
  
  
You will primarily own non-technology hiring for our Bengaluru innovation hub across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Finance (with occasional support on other roles as needed). You will do this as you strengthen the systems, documentation, training, and operational discipline that enable scalable recruiting. You'll partner cross-regionally to support global hiring initiatives and maintain consistency in tools, documentation, and quality standards in Konovo's Talent function without losing speed or ownership locally.
  
  
You will act as a trusted advisor to hiring leaders, bringing structure, clarity, and accountability to every search. Behind the scenes, you will ensure our hiring bar remains high and our processes disciplined, efficient, and equitable. Externally, you will represent Konovo with professionalism and warmth, cultivating an exceptional candidate experience at every stage. As Senior Talent Partner, your work will be critical to our success.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Own full-cycle hiring across non-technology functions that strengthen our India innovation hub and directly support business growth
* Own searches end-to-end as an individual contributor (intake and job search blueprint design, pipeline, coordination, interviews, offer, close) without a coordinator or sourcer, while partnering with and leveraging hiring managers as accountable partners in the process
* Increase hiring efficiency by reducing time-to-fill and improving candidate conversion
* Build operational rigour in Greenhouse by continuously optimising workflows, automations, reporting, and documentation to improve visibility and accountability
* Operate with urgency and ownership in a lean environment, balancing multiple priorities without waiting for direction
* Drive hiring manager accountability through tight intakes, qualification design, clear scorecards, fast feedback loops, and decision discipline
* Proactively leverage AI and automation to eliminate manual work, improve candidate evaluation quality, and increase recruiting throughput
* When a leader comes with a prescribed approach, you step back to clarify the outcome, surface assumptions and tradeoffs, and use your subject matter expertise to align stakeholders on the most effective path to a high-quality hire.
* Equip hiring managers to make stronger decisions by introducing structured interviewing, clearer evaluation criteria, and data-backed market insights
* Build repeatable hiring playbooks that enable future scale beyond India
* Partner directly with VP Talent, Managing Director, India, and executive leaders to translate business priorities into disciplined hiring plans
* Elevate candidate experience in a way that improves offer acceptance rates and long-term retention
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements that increase speed without lowering the hiring bar
* Strengthen global recruiting consistency by partnering cross-regionally to standardise tools, documentation, and quality standards
* Seek and incorporate feedback quickly, while confidently holding a high hiring bar
* Ensure every candidate interaction reflects Konovo's talent values that we're smart, nice, and get things done

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3+ years of in-house recruiting experience within a SaaS or technology-led environment
* Demonstrated ownership of full-cycle hiring across multiple functions and seniority levels
* Proven experience configuring and managing ATS workflows, ideally Greenhouse, including job setup, structured interview kits, automation, reporting, and workflow optimisation
* Comfort using AI and automation to reduce manual work (e.g. intake synthesis, outreach drafts, interview kits, reporting, information workflow streams, and documentation). You don't need formal "AI at work" experience, but you should be actively experimenting and able to apply it responsibly
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into recruiting workflows to drive measurable gains in efficiency or quality
* Strong operational mindset with the ability to build documentation, create structure, and drive process discipline
* Confidence partnering with senior leaders and influencing hiring decisions with data and market insights
* Experience supporting hiring across multiple geographies is a plus
* Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing 5+ concurrent searches
* Clear, concise communicator with sound judgement and high integrity
* High EQ with the confidence to challenge when needed and the humility to adapt quickly when coached
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, asking sharp questions early, and adapting quickly as priorities evolve
* Builder mindset- you are willing to do the work hands-on, improve the system as you go, and raise the hiring bar without adding unnecessary process

**Why Join Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is shaping the future of healthcare decision-making.
* Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility.
* Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance.
* Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience.
* Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.

This is just the beginning of what we can accomplish together. Join us at Konovo and help shape the future of healthcare technology!
  
  
**Apply now to be part of our journey.**

description:
At Ambitio, we're building India's first AI-powered global admissions platform to help students get into their dream schools. Our mission is to democratize access to quality global education by making the admissions process 10x easier through personalised AI guidance that combines advanced AI technology with alumni mentorship. We are backed by notable investors including BLinC Invest, First Cheque, & We Founder Circle.

As a Talent Acquisition Associate, you are the first point of contact for the people who will build Ambitio. * End-to-End Sales Hiring: Own the full cycle for sales roles (SDRs, BDAs, counsellors, team leads), from sourcing and screening to coordinating interviews, closing offers, and driving joining follow-ups against monthly hiring targets.

This is the ideal entry point for someone eager to learn innovative hiring practices at a fast-growing, global healthcare company where people are what make us great.
  
  

* Get hands-on exposure to recruiting at a fast-growing, PE-backed company scaling globally.

* Join a team that's smart, nice, and gets things done — and that shows you the same respect we ask of our candidates.

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition (Skillz)
description:
**About The Company**
If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career.
  
  
Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real-money, skill-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real-stakes competition possible at scale.
  
  
Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000+ daily tournaments. $7.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.
  
  
We're a high-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. We operate like a startup, hold ourselves to high standards, and move fast with purpose. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters — and be part of a team that fights for what it builds — Skillz is the right place.
  
  
**About The Role**
Skillz is looking for a Manager, Talent Acquisition to join our Bangalore team as second-in-command to the Senior Manager, TA. This is a hybrid role that blends hands-on recruiting with day-to-day team leadership. You'll own priority searches yourself while coaching and guiding a team of recruiters to hire high-quality talent across our technical and business functions.
  
  
You'll play a direct role in driving recruiting profitability: cutting time-to-fill, growing our direct-sourcing capability, and reducing our reliance on external agencies. At the same time, you'll build team capacity through coaching, consistent hiring standards, and hands-on problem-solving — stepping in as the Senior Manager's delegate to keep recruitment operations running smoothly as hiring demand grows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as second-in-command to the Senior Manager, TA; serve as their delegate, ensuring continuity of recruitment operations, and escalating risks in their absence.
* Own full-cycle recruiting for priority and hard-to-fill roles across technical, product, data, and business functions, with an emphasis on sourcing Tier 1 talent from B2C technology companies.
* Provide day-to-day leadership to a team of recruiters including coaching, setting clear expectations, reviewing performance, and delivering feedback that improves productivity.
* Build and maintain direct-sourcing pipelines and market maps to reduce agency dependency and raise quality of hire.
* Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to turn workforce priorities into structured search strategies and measurable hiring plans, constructively pushing back on requirements when needed.
* Track funnel metrics, conversion rates, and requisition ageing to spot bottlenecks and resolve operational blockers across the team's portfolio.
* Uphold hiring standards and process consistency to protect candidate experience and hit timelines.
* Lead offer negotiations and closing conversations, managing compensation expectations and counteroffers to land great talent within budget.
* Build lasting relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and stakeholders across the business.
* Support the Senior Manager, TA in driving down time-to-fill and minimizing the productivity loss that comes with open roles.

**Key Competencies**

* Team Leadership & Coaching — guiding recruiters, setting expectations, and improving team performance.
* Technical & Business Acumen — fluent in evaluating engineering, product, and data talent from Tier 1 B2C companies.
* Strategic Recruiting — translating priorities into search strategies, market maps, and hiring plans.
* Stakeholder Management — building credibility with leaders and constructively challenging requirements.
* Execution & Accountability — strong ownership of outcomes, timelines, and candidate experience.
* Data-Driven Decision-Making — using metrics to spot risk and improve outcomes.
* Problem-Solving & Adaptability — resolving bottlenecks and thriving amid shifting priorities.
* Offer Negotiation & Closing — managing compensation conversations and counteroffers with confidence.
* Relationship Building — sustaining trust across candidates, recruiters, and stakeholders.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record hiring technical, product, data, or business talent.
* 1–2+ years formally managing, mentoring, or leading recruiters day-to-day.
* Demonstrated success hiring Tier 1 talent from B2C technology, consumer internet, gaming, fintech, e-commerce, travel-tech, food-tech, or other scaled consumer businesses.
* Experience running priority or hard-to-fill searches independently while overseeing other recruiters' delivery.
* Strong direct-sourcing skills; experience with building market maps and proactive pipelines without heavy reliance on agencies.
* End-to-end recruitment lifecycle experience: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debriefs, references, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Background in a startup, turnaround, or fast-scaling environment where priorities shift quickly.
* A track record of tenure and growth; ideally two-plus years at one or more organizations, with internal promotions or expanded scope.
* Genuine interest in gaming, consumer technology, and digital products.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate and work regularly from the Skillz Bangalore office.
* Background hiring for B2C tier-1 profiles at B2C tech companies (not consulting/agency-side).

**Location:**
Hybrid in Bangalore, India
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%
  
  
**Why Skillz**

* You're building infrastructure, not just features. Skillz is the competition layer for mobile gaming — the matchmaking, payments, identity, and fraud systems that make real-stakes competition trustworthy at scale. The work here compounds. Every improvement to the platform makes every tournament on it better.
* Founder-led. Andrew Paradise founded Skillz in 2012 with a single conviction: that fair, real-money skill-based competition should exist at scale. Thirteen years later, he’s taken the company public on the NYSE, built a portfolio of three independent businesses, earned 90+ patents, and won the largest false advertising verdict in U.S. history. He is still here — still the founder, still the CEO, still building. That kind of long-term commitment and alignment is rare in any company. At Skillz, it defines the culture from the top down.
* Part of a compounding ecosystem. Skillz is one of three businesses inside FIRY — alongside RZR, our AI-powered performance ad network, and Beamable, our developer backend platform. Your work spans gaming, ad tech, identity, payments, and ecommerce. The platform you build on gets smarter and more valuable with every player, developer, and advertiser that enters the ecosystem.
* Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more.
* Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays.
* Las Vegas Headquarters. Skillz operates in a five-day-a-week, collaborative office environment at our 36,000+ square foot Las Vegas HQ. Free daily catered lunch, snacks, a full-size gym with showers, commuter benefits, team events, and more.
* Recognized Success. Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.

Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!
  
  
Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. We look forward to having you on board!

description:
***Company Description***

The company specializes in tailored procurement services and turnkey solutions that focus on guest experience, operational efficiency, and aesthetic impact. The team collaborates closely with clients from concept development through procurement, logistics, and installation, ensuring customized solutions and high levels of customer satisfaction. Applicants can expect to join a professional, detail-oriented organization committed to creating exceptional spaces for a diverse portfolio of projects.*

*Job Description: Talent Acquisition Specialist*

***Location:***
*Bengaluru (Head Office)*

***Work Mode:***
*Full-time, Work from Office*

***Experience:***
*Minimum 1 year of full-time experience in recruitment*

***Qualification:***
*Minimum Bachelor’s Degree*

***Maximum Budget:***
*₹3.5 LPA*

*Role Overview*

*We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented*
***Talent Acquisition Specialist***
*with a minimum of 1 year of full-time experience in end-to-end Non-IT recruitment. The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, and ensuring successful candidate onboarding.*

*The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, excellent stakeholder management abilities, and the capability to close positions within tight deadlines. Experience in product-based companies or retail environments will be an added advantage.*

*Key Responsibilities*

* ***End-to-End Recruitment:***
  *Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for Non-IT positions across various departments and organizational levels, including mid-level to senior leadership and head-level openings.*
* ***Requirement Gathering:***
  *Coordinate with internal teams and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, job specifications, experience criteria, and hiring priorities.*
* ***Job Description Preparation:***
  *Prepare clear and relevant job descriptions based on business requirements and ensure timely posting across suitable recruitment platforms.*
* ***Candidate Sourcing:***
  *Source candidates through multiple recruitment portals and platforms, including Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Joghai, WorkIndia, Apna, Monster, and other relevant job boards and professional networks.*
* ***Profile Screening:***
  *Understand job requirements thoroughly and screen resumes effectively to identify suitable candidates and maintain a strong pipeline of quality profiles.*
* ***Recruitment Agency Management:***
  *Identify, onboard, and coordinate with recruitment agencies to source relevant profiles and fulfil hiring requirements within agreed timelines.*
* ***Interview Coordination:***
  *Coordinate with hiring managers, interview panels, and candidates to schedule interviews, share feedback, and ensure a smooth and timely selection process.*
* ***Candidate Follow-up and Closure:***
  *Maintain continuous communication with shortlisted candidates, manage follow-ups, negotiate compensation within approved budgets, address concerns, and convince selected candidates to join.*
* ***Offer Management and Joining:***
  *Follow up with selected candidates throughout the offer and pre-joining stages to minimize offer dropouts and ensure successful joining.*
* ***Stakeholder Management:***
  *Build and maintain strong professional relationships with hiring managers, internal teams, recruitment agencies, and candidates.*
* ***Recruitment Tracking and Reporting:***
  *Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment trackers covering hiring requirements, sourcing channels, candidate details, interview stages, feedback, offers, joining status, and position closure timelines.*
* ***Timely Position Closure:***
  *Prioritize open positions, manage multiple requirements simultaneously, and ensure vacancies are closed within tight deadlines without compromising candidate quality.*
* ***Blue-Collar Recruitment:***
  *Handle blue-collar hiring requirements whenever required, using appropriate sourcing channels and recruitment strategies.*
* ***Employer Branding:***
  *Support employer branding initiatives and promote the organization as an attractive workplace to prospective candidates.*
* ***Process Improvement:***
  *Identify sourcing challenges, resolve recruitment bottlenecks, and adopt effective strategies to improve hiring efficiency and quality.*

*Qualifications and Skills*

* *Minimum*
  ***1 year of full-time experience***
  *in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or HR, preferably with hands-on experience in end-to-end Non-IT recruitment.*
* *Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or any relevant discipline.*
* *Practical experience sourcing candidates through job portals, recruitment agencies, professional networks, and other relevant channels.*
* *Experience hiring across multiple departments, including:*
* *Accounts and Finance*
* *Warehouse and Inventory*
* *Procurement and Supply Chain*
* *Backend Sales*
* *Sales and Marketing*
* *Business Operations*
* *Human Resources*
* *Other corporate, operational, and blue-collar functions as required.*
* *Ability to recruit across different seniority levels, from mid-level positions to senior management and head-level roles.*
* *Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong candidate engagement, negotiation, and convincing abilities.*
* *Strong understanding of job descriptions, candidate evaluation, resume screening, interview coordination, and offer management.*
* *Good stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, hiring managers, interviewers, and external recruitment agencies.*
* *Strong organizational, time-management, multitasking, and follow-up skills.*
* *A proactive attitude, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced recruitment environment.*
* *Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), recruitment trackers, and hiring metrics is preferred.*
* *Experience in a*
  ***product-based company or retail environment***
  *will be an added advantage.*
* *Experience onboarding and managing recruitment agencies will be preferred.*

*Ideal Candidate Profile*

*The ideal candidate is hands-on, target-oriented, and capable of independently managing multiple Non-IT hiring requirements. They should be proactive in sourcing, effective in screening quality profiles, confident in negotiating with candidates and stakeholders, and committed to achieving timely closures while maintaining a positive candidate experience.*

***Compensation:***
*Maximum budget of ₹3.5 LPA.*

***Important:***
*This is a full-time, on-site position based at our head office in Bengaluru. Candidates should be comfortable working from the office and managing recruitment requirements within defined timelines and approved compensation budgets.*

title: Sr Recruiter
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job develops and executes strategic recruiting plans to attract top talent. They partner with hiring managers to understand specific hiring needs and create job descriptions. Senior Recruiters source and screen candidates, conduct interviews, and assist in the selection and offer process. They also manage relationships with candidates and hiring managers, develop recruiting metrics, and may supervise junior recruiters. With extensive experience in recruiting, they utilize advanced sourcing tools and techniques to ensure the company hires the best talent
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Partner with hiring managers and business unit leader to understand hiring requirements, products and services while providing consultative expertise in recruitment.
* Lead & develop recruiting strategies and manage the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, delivering an efficient and effective recruiting partnership.

* Collaborates regularly with peers and/or internal partners

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**What You Need To Know About The Role-**
This role is for Technical Recruiter to join the India Talent Acquisition team. Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll play a key role in shaping and rolling out TA initiatives and projects including recruitment campaigns & marketing, diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging hiring, and our Global TA transformation.
  
  
**Meet our team**
-
  
  
The TA team is based out of Bangalore in India.
  
  
The hiring TA team is responsible for achieving headcount needs for the Engineering & Products organization.
**Job Description:**
**Your way to impact-**
You will own end-to-end hiring activities across some of our most critical business areas across the India region, partnering closely with Coordination, Onboarding, and Sourcing. Additionally, you'll engage closely with leaders on the site, the broader HR community, and the Global GTA team.
  
  
**Your day to day-**

* Achieves staffing objectives by recruiting and evaluating job candidates; advising managers
* Educating and guiding hiring managers on Talent Acquisition related policies, processes, and interview skills.
* Developing innovative recruitment strategies and managing the end-to-end hiring activities, delivering an efficient and effective service to all involved in the hiring process.
* Monitor and ensure 100% compliance with hiring process activities and resolve any discrepancies that may arise prior to the completion of the hiring process
* Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
* Use various sourcing platforms and techniques LinkedIn, Boolean strings, X-ray search, and other select sourcing tools to further build a robust pipeline of top-tier candidates
* Assist in identifying, organizing, attending, and participating in sourcing channels, such as community outreach events, job fairs, Meetups, conferences, educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and social networking activities, on behalf of PayPal, in order to promote PayPal’s employer-brand
* Conduct thorough pre-screen activities in line with PayPal and job requirements, and presents a shortlist and recommendations of the most suitable candidates for consideration for assigned requisitions.
* Support the administration and coordination of the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, ensuring an efficient and effective service is delivered to all involved in the hiring process.
* Prepare, present, and negotiate job offers in accordance with PayPal compensation and benefits guidelines.
* Manage and actively participate in Talent Acquisition related projects of varying complexity, importance, and priority.
* Represent the Talent Acquisition team positively in relationships and communication with the Human Resource Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, business leaders, and other Global Talent Acquisition team members.

**What Do You Need To Bring-**

* 5 + years experience with full life cycle talent acquisition in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* Comfortable to multitask, project management, and presentation skills coupled with technical / business acumen
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment of change, challenge, and multiple deadlines and priorities
* Experience handling sensitive/confidential information
* Networking, and relationship-building skills
* High level of comfort with direct sourcing

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**HR Intern**

**PropSarathi**

**Location:**
Sathnur, near REVA University, North Bengaluru

**Type:**
Full-time, in-office internship

**Stipend:**
₹10,000 per month, payable on achievement of monthly targets

**Reporting to:**
Founder & Business Head

**About PropSarathi**

**PropSarathi is a real estate advisory and channel partner firm focused on North Bengaluru, with a growing presence in Dubai and across India. We work with leading developers and help buyers and investors make confident property decisions. We are building a team that moves fast, takes ownership, and grows with the company.**

**Why This Role Matters**

**HR at PropSarathi is not a back-office function. You will build the team that sells, supports, and grows the company. From the first candidate you source to the last onboarding document you close, you will shape how people join, perform, and stay with us. You will get direct access to the Founder, real decisions and visible results.**

**What You Will Do**

*Talent Acquisition*

* Source candidates for every open position across sales, marketing, content, operations and admin, using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, campus outreach and community channels
* Write and publish job posts for each role and keep them updated
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates against role requirements
* Schedule, coordinate, and follow up on interviews, and collect structured feedback
* Maintain a live hiring tracker covering source, stage, status, timelines, and drop-off reasons
* Build and maintain a talent pool of pre-screened candidates for future openings
* Coordinate reference checks and final-stage paperwork

*Offers & Documentation*

* Prepare offer, appointment, and internship letters from approved templates
* Track acceptances, joining dates, and document collection
* Coordinate background and document verification
* Maintain confidential employee files, including ID, address, education and experience records

*Onboarding*

* Plan and run the joining process: welcome, system access, tools, introductions and first-week schedule
* Prepare an onboarding checklist for each role and track completion
* Brief new joiners on company policies, culture and expectations
* Follow up at 7, 30, and 60 days to check settling-in and early concerns

*Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination*

* Maintain attendance and leave records
* Collect timesheets and inputs needed for monthly payroll, and coordinate with accounts
* Track stipend and salary eligibility against approved targets
* Process leave requests and maintain leave balances

*Performance Management*

* Set up monthly and quarterly review cycles with managers
* Maintain performance records, goals, and review outcomes
* Flag underperformance early and coordinate improvement plans with managers
* Track incentive and target sheets for HR-related roles, in coordination with the Founder

*Employee Engagement & Culture*

* Be the first point of contact for employee questions and day-to-day concerns
* Plan team meetings, training sessions, celebrations, and internal events
* Run monthly engagement check-ins and act on feedback
* Build and maintain a learning calendar with training topics for each function

*Policies & Compliance*

* Maintain the employee handbook, HR policies and code of conduct
* Ensure every employee has signed the relevant agreements, including confidentiality and non-disclosure
* Track statutory and compliance deadlines relevant to employees, in coordination with accounts and legal
* Manage exits: resignation processing, notice periods, handover checklists, full and final settlement coordination, and exit feedback

*Reporting & Analytics*

* Prepare a monthly HR report covering headcount, hiring funnel, time-to-hire, attrition, attendance, and open roles
* Maintain dashboards and trackers in Google Sheets
* Share insights and recommendations with the Founder

*Employer Brand*

* Support content for LinkedIn and recruitment posts, in line with PropSarathi's brand guidelines
* Showcase team achievements and culture moments on social channels

**What We Are Looking For**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field
* Strong written and spoken English, with Hindi and Kannada as a plus
* Confident using Google Sheets or MS Excel, including basic formulas and filters
* Comfortable with LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email and online job portals
* Organised, proactive and able to manage several hiring processes at once
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information
* Genuine interest in people, recruitment and building teams
* Interest in real estate or sales-led organisations is a strong plus
* Able to commute to our Sathnur office

**Targets & Stipend**

**The ₹15,000 monthly stipend is payable on achievement of targets agreed with the Founder at the start of each month:**

* 40 qualified candidates sourced across all open roles
* 15 interviews scheduled and coordinated
* 100% of onboarding checklists completed on time
* 100% of attendance and leave records updated by the 5th of each month
* Monthly HR report submitted by the 3rd working day of the following month

**What You Will Gain**

* End-to-end HR experience across recruitment, onboarding, performance, compliance and exits
* Direct mentorship from the Founder and a front-row seat to how a growing real estate firm is built
* A strong portfolio of HR work to take into your next role
* A pathway to a full-time HR role at PropSarathi based on performance

**How to Apply**

**Send your CV and a short note on why you want to build people operations at PropSarathi to pareekshith@propsarathi.com or call/whatsapp on +91 8884401147. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview at our Sathnur office.**

**Job Description – HR Executive**

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Company:**
NovL Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive to manage end-to-end talent acquisition and recruitment activities, along with team handling and coordination. The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, good communication abilities, and the capability to manage recruitment teams and ensure timely closure of open positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition & End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand job descriptions, candidate profiles, and hiring priorities.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidates based on role requirements.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates and interview panels to ensure a smooth recruitment process.
* Manage salary discussions, offer negotiations, and offer releases in coordination with management.
* Track candidate progress, maintain recruitment records, and ensure timely follow-ups until joining.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, interview-to-selection ratio, offer acceptance, and joining ratio.

**2. Recruitment Team Handling**

* Manage and coordinate the day-to-day activities of the recruitment team.
* Allocate hiring requirements among recruiters based on priorities and expertise.
* Monitor recruiter productivity, sourcing activities, interview schedules, and closure targets.
* Conduct regular team reviews to track recruitment progress and identify hiring bottlenecks.
* Guide team members on sourcing strategies, candidate screening, and effective recruitment practices.
* Ensure recruiters meet hiring deadlines and maintain the required quality of candidate submissions.
* Support the team in closing critical and challenging positions.
* Prepare and share recruitment status reports with management.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination within the team to achieve overall hiring targets.

**3. Recruitment Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated recruitment tracker and candidate database.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Track open positions, shortlisted candidates, interviews, offers, and joining status.
* Ensure timely communication with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Identify process improvements to increase sourcing efficiency and recruitment turnaround time.

**Required Skills**

* 2–5 years of experience in talent acquisition and end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience in handling or coordinating a recruitment team.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques and recruitment platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and work towards hiring targets.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and recruitment tracking tools.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely closure of open positions.
* Quality of candidate submissions and selections.
* Recruiter productivity and team target achievement.
* Offer acceptance and candidate joining ratios.
* Accuracy of recruitment reports and candidate tracking.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A hands-on HR professional with strong end-to-end recruitment experience, the ability to manage multiple hiring requirements, and the leadership skills to coordinate and drive a recruitment team towards timely hiring closures.

title: Technical Talent Partner
description:
**About the Opportunity:**

Join a globally recognized, product-led technology company focused on building innovative software solutions and delivering meaningful value to customers worldwide.

We’re looking for a
**Technical Talent Partner**
who understands the software engineering talent market and is passionate about helping product and engineering teams grow. In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering leaders, technical leads, and hiring managers to shape recruitment strategies and attract exceptional mid- to senior-level talent, particularly across software development and engineering.

More than filling vacancies, you’ll serve as a trusted talent advisor—bringing market insights, targeted sourcing strategies, and a consultative approach to help build high-performing engineering teams and support long-term product growth.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Partner with software product and engineering teams to understand product roadmaps, technical priorities, team growth plans, and hiring requirements.
* Own the end-to-end technical recruitment process for mid- to senior-level IT positions, with a primary focus on software development and engineering roles.
* Collaborate with engineering leads and hiring managers to define role requirements, assess talent needs, and align on effective recruitment strategies.
* Build targeted talent pipelines for software engineers, developers, and other technical professionals through market mapping, direct sourcing, networking, and Boolean search.
* Provide technical talent market insights on candidate availability, skill demand, compensation trends, and competitive hiring conditions to guide recruitment decisions.
* Act as a strategic talent advisor, helping hiring teams refine requirements, evaluate candidate profiles, and navigate challenging technical searches.
* Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback, and a thoughtful, engaging recruitment process.
* Use recruitment metrics and funnel insights to monitor hiring progress, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve recruitment outcomes.
* Support the long-term growth of software product teams by anticipating talent needs and building relationships with qualified technical professionals before vacancies arise.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Technical Recruitment, or Talent Partnering.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment for mid- to senior-level technology roles, particularly software development or software engineering positions.
* Strong understanding of software engineering talent profiles and the ability to identify relevant technical skills and experience.
* Experience partnering directly with engineering managers, technical leads, product teams, or other technology stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to develop sourcing strategies and attract talent in competitive technical markets.
* Proficiency in Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, talent mapping, and other candidate research techniques.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to provide market insights and influence hiring decisions.
* A data-driven, proactive, and consultative mindset, with a focus on hiring quality and long-term team growth.
* Experience supporting global or distributed technology teams is an advantage.

**Why Consider This Opportunity?**

* Join a Tier 1 global technology organization with a strong focus on software product innovation.
* Work closely with software product teams and engineering leaders, directly contributing to their growth and success.
* Manage meaningful mid- to senior-level technical searches rather than focusing solely on high-volume or transactional recruitment.
* Gain exposure to global talent markets, complex technical hiring challenges, and strategic stakeholder partnerships.
* Build your career as a consultative Talent Partner who influences hiring decisions and helps shape high-performing engineering teams.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are a technically minded recruitment professional who enjoys partnering with engineering leaders, identifying exceptional software development talent, and helping product teams scale, this opportunity offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a global technology organization.

title: US IT Recruiter – Emerging AI Roles
description:
**Job title:**
IT Recruiter - Emerging AI Roles
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**Work type:**
Full-time, On-site (US shift)
  
  
Findem is hiring a Bangalore-based IT Recruiter, working the US shift, to fill the new roles AI is creating for our clients.
  
  
**About Findem**
Findem is the AI-powered talent acquisition platform redefining how leading companies discover, attract and hire talent. Our agentic platform combines enriched 3D data on hundreds of millions of professionals with autonomous agents that do the work of modern talent teams.
  
  
Outcome Operations delivers hiring as an outcome: clients buy hires, not seats. Agents do the work that scales; people do the work that doesn’t, like judgment, persuasion, calibration and relationships.
  
  
**About The Role**
AI is creating roles such as Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Enablement Specialist and AI Governance, and our clients’ hiring managers are often filling them for the first time. That makes these searches hard. Requirements start vague, they change as the hiring manager learns, and few candidates have done the job before.
  
  
You’ll turn that ambiguity into hires. You’ll work directly with US hiring managers to define the ideal candidate, find people whose experience fits even when their title doesn’t, and present a slate every week that gets sharper with each round of feedback. You’ll use Claude and Findem’s agents to move fast; the judgment, relationships and conviction are yours.
  
  
**Role at a glance**

* Shift: US shift, aligned to US hiring managers’ business hours (evening to early morning IST)

**What You’ll Do**
Your week revolves around a standing meeting with each hiring manager, and everything else feeds into the next one.
  
  

* Shape the role with the hiring manager: Work directly with IT Directors, Directors and VPs of Field Services to understand who they picture as the ideal candidate. Help first-time hiring managers separate must-haves from nice-to-haves and pin down the actual work
* Adapt as requirements change: Capture each change the hiring manager makes, confirm it with them, and re-aim the search the same week
* Map adjacent talent: Few people have held these titles, so identify backgrounds that transfer, such as solutions or implementation engineers for a Forward Deployed Engineer role. Use market data to show hiring managers how many people match their profile, and adjust it with them when the pool is too thin
* Run the weekly candidate cadence: Present a new set of candidates to each hiring manager every week. Gather feedback on candidates and interviews, and use recorded meeting notes so nothing is lost
* Champion strong candidates: Build conviction about the candidates you believe in and explain with evidence why each one will succeed
* Source with Claude and Findem: Use Claude, the Findem MCP and Findem search tools to find best-match candidates, and refine the search after every round of feedback
* Engage and sell candidates: Reach out by email, LinkedIn and phone. Many candidates have never seen this job before, so explain what it is, why it matters and why they fit. Review outreach emails so they describe the role accurately
* Keep records current: Update each candidate’s Findem record with contact details, notes after every conversation, and feedback about the client
* Screen with Glider: Get candidates to complete the Glider test. Work with hiring managers on interview questions, map each one to a specific requirement, and refine the questions to filter out poor fits
* Partner with client recruiters: Coordinate with client recruiters supporting the same roles so no candidate is contacted twice, and build relationships that earn you more of their future roles

**List 2: What success looks like**

* Every hiring manager gets a new slate on schedule, every week
* All hiring-manager feedback is captured, and the next search reflects it
* The candidates you champion advance through interviews to offers and hires
* The Glider test filters out poor fits before they reach the hiring manager
* Client recruiters bring you their next roles

**What You’ll Bring**

* 4-8 years of IT or technical recruiting, including full-cycle work for US hiring managers (agency, RPO or in-house)
* A track record of filling hard-to-fill or brand-new roles where candidates don’t fit a standard title
* Confidence with Directors and VPs: you can run an intake, ask probing questions and push back with data
* Enough AI literacy to discuss roles like Forward Deployed Engineer or AI Governance credibly, and the curiosity to learn the rest fast
* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude in your recruiting work, plus strong search skills across sourcing platforms and LinkedIn
* Persuasive written and spoken English, and the confidence to sell a role to US candidates by phone
* Discipline with notes, follow-ups and pipeline data
* Willingness to work the US shift from our Bangalore office

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Findem, Glider, or similar sourcing and assessment platforms
* Recruiting for solutions engineering, professional services or field services teams
* Agency or RPO experience managing several clients alongside their internal recruiters
* Experience designing structured interview or screening questions

**Why this role**

* Recruit for the jobs AI is creating, and build expertise few recruiters have yet
* Work AI-first every day with Claude, Findem’s agentic platform and Glider
* Partner directly with senior US technology leaders, not through layers
* Join a team that measures its work in hires delivered

Equal Opportunity
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
**Summary**
The People – Talent Attraction team builds the capabilities, culture, and clarity Guidewire needs for continued growth. We partner globally to strengthen talent engines, improve candidate and employee experiences, expand inclusive leadership pipelines, and use technology, data, and automation to work smarter. Our environment is collaborative, curious, accountable, and focused on continuous improvement, with a strong emphasis on AI fluency and scalable hiring practices.
  
  
This role leads confidential, high-impact searches for senior leaders who will help Guidewire transform how the world’s property and casualty insurers do business. You will shape executive hiring strategy, advise senior stakeholders, and build trusted relationships with exceptional passive talent across technology and SaaS markets. Your work will strengthen leadership capability, support Guidewire’s growth, and contribute to a consistent, high-quality candidate experience.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Lead end-to-end executive searches for VP, Director, Head of Engineering, Product, Sales, and other senior leadership roles, translating business priorities into clear search strategies and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with executives, hiring managers, Human Resources Business Partners, and business leaders to define leadership requirements, assess organizational needs, and align hiring decisions with Guidewire’s growth plans.
* Build talent maps, competitor intelligence, and sustained pipelines across SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and technology-product organizations.
* Identify and engage passive candidates through executive search partners, professional networks, referrals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and industry relationships while maintaining discretion and confidentiality.
* Assess leadership capability, strategic thinking, team-building, product-led growth experience, SaaS understanding, and alignment with Guidewire’s collaborative and purpose-driven culture.
* Manage complex interview processes, influence selection decisions, and coordinate compensation benchmarking, equity or long-term incentive considerations, and offer negotiations with the appropriate teams.
* Deliver a personalized, high-touch executive candidate experience and provide leaders with market insights on talent availability, competitor movement, diversity, compensation, and hiring trends.
* Track and communicate executive hiring metrics, including time to fill, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance, source effectiveness, and hiring outcomes, using data to improve recruitment strategy and execution.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Required**
**What you’ll bring**

* Significant experience leading executive search and senior leadership hiring in a technology, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, or comparable product-company environment.
* Minimum 15 years of experience into Recruitment (Min. 10 years into Executive Hiring)
* Demonstrated ability to engage passive candidates and build trusted relationships with senior leaders and executive-level talent.
* Strong stakeholder-management and advisory skills, with the judgment and confidence to influence hiring decisions at senior levels.
* Experience developing talent maps, market intelligence, competitor insights, and proactive leadership pipelines.
* Skilled leadership assessment capabilities, including evaluation of strategic thinking, organizational leadership, team development, business impact, and cultural contribution.
* Experience partnering on executive compensation benchmarking and negotiating complex offers involving incentives, equity, or long-term rewards.
* Excellent communication, organization, discretion, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple confidential searches and deliver timely outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred**

* Degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience recruiting leaders for global organizations or across multiple international markets.
* Familiarity with property and casualty insurance, InsurTech, cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems, talent-intelligence tools, executive-search analytics, and structured assessment approaches.
* Experience advancing inclusive leadership hiring through broad sourcing strategies and consistent, job-related evaluation practices.

**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will establish trusted partnerships with senior stakeholders, understand Guidewire’s leadership priorities, create targeted talent maps for critical functions, and build or strengthen executive pipelines across priority technology markets. You will introduce clear search strategies, provide actionable market intelligence, improve pipeline and source reporting, and help deliver an efficient, confidential candidate experience. Your work will support scalable growth, stronger leadership capability, and the continued evolution of Guidewire as a cloud and AI platform committed to customer success.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
  

* Flexible work environment
* Health and Wellness benefits
* Paid time off programs including volunteer time off
* Market-competitive pay and incentive programs
* Continual development and internal career growth opportunities

Guidewire combines digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver its platform as a cloud service and is committed to customer success. You will join a culture grounded in determination, collaboration, continuous improvement, and bravery, where people are encouraged to learn, contribute, and grow together.
  
  
Guidewire embraces a culture of in-person interviews for all applicants and onsite orientation for all new hires.
  
  
Guidewire is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible hiring experience. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, business needs, and organizational requirements. We welcome varied perspectives and do not make assumptions about candidates based on personal characteristics or background.
  
  
**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.
  
  
Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven
**HR Talent Acquisition Intern**
with an engineering background and prior hands-on experience in Talent Acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the HR Manager and hiring teams to manage recruitment execution across multiple technical and non-technical positions.

You will be responsible for sourcing and screening relevant candidates through LinkedIn Hiring and other channels, managing recruitment workflows on Keka ATS, coordinating interviews, ensuring timely feedback, and driving candidates through the hiring process to onboarding.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, communicates confidently, takes ownership of targets, and can manage multiple positions simultaneously.

**Role Details**

* **Location:**
  Bengaluru
* **Working Model:**
  Full-time, Work From Office (5 days a week)
* **Internship Duration:**
  3 months
* **Monthly Stipend:**
  ₹20,000
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiners preferred
* **Open Positions:**
  1

The internship may be extended or converted into a full-time opportunity depending on the intern's performance, business requirements, and hiring needs at the end of the internship.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Sourcing and Screening**

* Source relevant candidates for assigned technical and non-technical internship and full-time positions using LinkedIn Hiring and other relevant sourcing channels.
* Screen profiles against job requirements and shortlist candidates who meet the role's technical, functional, and experience criteria.
* Conduct initial candidate calls to assess fitment, communication, interest, availability, and compensation expectations, wherever applicable.
* Clearly communicate Convin's business, the role, responsibilities, and recruitment process to prospective candidates.
* Manage 3–4 open positions simultaneously while maintaining sourcing quality and recruitment timelines.

**2. Interview Scheduling and Coordination**

* Schedule candidate interviews with internal stakeholders using Keka ATS and ensure all interview details are communicated accurately.
* Meet daily interview scheduling targets consistently.
* Proactively coordinate with candidates and interviewers to ensure interviews happen as scheduled and participants join on time.
* Follow up on interview confirmations, rescheduling, cancellations, and no-shows to minimize delays in the hiring process.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

**3. Recruitment Operations and ATS Management**

* Use Keka ATS daily to manage candidate pipelines, schedule interviews, track hiring progress, and maintain accurate recruitment records.
* Ensure interview feedback is submitted by interviewers on Keka ATS after every interview.
* Follow up with hiring managers and interviewers for pending feedback and hiring decisions.
* Keep candidate statuses, interview stages, and recruitment trackers updated and accurate.
* Ensure adherence to the defined recruitment process and timely closure of action items.

**4. Target Achievement and Hiring Execution**

* Work towards defined monthly hiring and onboarding targets and daily interview scheduling targets.
* Track recruitment progress against assigned targets and proactively address bottlenecks that may affect hiring outcomes.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements, priorities, and candidate evaluation criteria.
* Drive candidates through the recruitment funnel, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination, selection, offer rollout, and onboarding.
* Take ownership of assigned positions and ensure recruitment activities are completed within agreed timelines.

**5. Stakeholder and Candidate Management**

* Build effective working relationships with hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates.
* Communicate with clarity, confidence, and professionalism while handling recruitment-related discussions and follow-ups.
* Handle competing priorities, last-minute changes, and recruitment challenges with a solution-oriented approach.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience through timely updates, professional communication, and consistent follow-through.

**Must-Haves**

* Completed a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or currently pursuing the final semester of an engineering degree.
* At least 6 months of hands-on Talent Acquisition internship experience.
* Practical experience using LinkedIn Hiring/LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Experience hiring for both internship and full-time positions.
* Exposure to both technical and non-technical recruitment.
* Prior experience managing at least 3–4 open positions simultaneously.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup or similarly high-ownership environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with clarity of thought and a structured approach to communication.
* Confidence in speaking with candidates, explaining roles, assessing initial fitment, and managing recruitment-related calls.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, time-management, and organizational skills.
* A target-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability and ownership.
* Available to join immediately and commit to the full 3-month internship duration.
* Willingness to work full-time from Convin's Bengaluru office, five days a week.

**Good-to-Haves**

* Experience recruiting for engineering, software development, AI/ML, data, product, or other technology roles.
* Experience hiring interns through campus recruitment, college networks, job portals, or LinkedIn.
* Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as sourcing-to-screening conversion, interview scheduling, interview attendance, offer acceptance, and joining ratios.
* Experience working with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to understand role requirements and close positions.
* Experience managing candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
* Ability to identify process gaps, improve recruitment coordination, and suggest ways to improve hiring turnaround time.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize multiple requirements without compromising candidate experience.

**What You Will Gain**

* Hands-on experience managing recruitment for technical and non-technical roles in a growing AI startup.
* Exposure to end-to-end Talent Acquisition, from sourcing and screening to selection, offer coordination, and onboarding.
* Opportunities to work directly with the HR Manager and internal hiring stakeholders.
* Practical experience using LinkedIn Hiring and Keka ATS while working with measurable recruitment targets.
* The opportunity to build strong stakeholder-management, communication, and execution skills.

**Selection Process**

* **Round 1 – HR Fitment Check:**
  Discussion with the HR Manager to assess prior experience, communication, role understanding, and overall fitment.
* **Round 2 – IQ Assessment:**
  Assessment of logical reasoning and problem-solving ability.
* **Round 3 – Case Study / On-the-Spot Assignment:**
  A practical recruitment assignment with the HR Manager to evaluate sourcing, screening, prioritization, communication, and execution skills.
* **Final Decision and Offer:**
  Selected candidates will receive an offer following the final evaluation.

5+ years
  
  
**Function:**
Human Resources

: Contingent Worker
  
  
**Every great journey starts with a single step. Help us make that step unforgettable.**
At Booking Holdings, travel is more than just getting from point A to point B. It’s about the feeling you get when you step into a new place, the people you meet, and the memories that stick with you forever. Through brands like Booking.com, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable, we help millions of people experience the world every single day.
  
  
Behind all of that technology is something far simpler and more human: people.
  
  
At our India Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bangalore, we’re building teams that think differently, care deeply, and solve big problems together. But finding those fresh perspectives, the students and graduates who bring new energy, curiosity, and bold ideas, takes care, effort, and heart.
  
  
**That’s where you come in.**
We’re looking for an Early Careers Specialist who genuinely cares about people at the very beginning of their professional lives. If you remember what it felt like to look for your first big opportunity—and want to build experiences that make candidates feel seen, supported, and excited—we’d love to welcome you to our team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
In this role, you won't just be coordinating interview schedules or managing spreadsheets though process rigor is a big part of what keeps us grounded. You’ll be the bridge between talented young people and their future careers.
  
  
Working side by side with our Early Careers Lead, you’ll take care of the end-to-end details that turn campus strategy into real, memorable candidate experiences.
  
  
**Bring Humanity to Campus Recruitment**

* Be a welcoming, clear, and reassuring contact for students, placement teams, and university leaders as we connect across campuses in India.
* Organize and host events, from campus sessions to hackathons and Q&As, that feel authentic, informative, and inclusive rather than performative.
* Ensure every candidate feels valued throughout their journey with us, from their very first application through offer stage and day one.

**Keep the Engine Running Smoothly**

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**About The Team**
Our mission at Zillow is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. As part of Zillow Group’s Talent Acquisition team, you’ll help shape the future of our organization by attracting and hiring top talent. We are a collaborative, data-informed, and candidate-focused team that serves as the first impression of Zillow Group’s culture, values, and vision.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Technical Recruiter**
to help build high-performing engineering and technology teams in a fast-paced, product-driven environment. This role is ideal for someone who understands technology hiring beyond job descriptions—someone who can engage deeply with engineering leaders, understand complex technical talent requirements, and build thoughtful strategies to identify and close exceptional talent.
  
  
**You Will Get To**

* Own end-to-end technical recruiting for complex and high-impact engineering roles, from intake through offer and close.
* Partner with Engineering leaders and Hiring Managers to understand business priorities, team structures, technical requirements, and talent gaps.
* Translate technical requirements into effective talent strategies and sourcing plans, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of high-quality engineering talent across relevant technology ecosystems.
* Conduct meaningful candidate conversations and demonstrate the ability to understand and assess technical experience, career progression, scope, and impact.
* Use a combination of direct sourcing, market mapping, referrals, networking, research, and talent communities to identify passive candidates.
* Develop a strong understanding of the competitive technology talent landscape, including companies, skills, compensation trends, and candidate motivations.
* Partner with Hiring Managers throughout the interview process to ensure speed, quality, consistency, and an exceptional candidate experience.
* Drive offer strategy and close senior and highly sought-after technical talent, understanding motivations beyond compensation.
* Use recruiting data and market insights to identify bottlenecks, improve conversion, and influence hiring decisions.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 8–12 years of recruiting experience, with significant experience hiring for software engineering and technology organizations.
* Proven experience recruiting within technology product companies, SaaS, cloud, consumer technology, fintech, marketplaces, or other engineering-led organizations.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and technical leaders and understand technology stacks, engineering environments, and technical career paths.
* Demonstrated success in passive candidate sourcing and talent mapping, particularly for difficult-to-fill roles.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Hiring Managers and challenge assumptions when required.
* Experience managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality and experience.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use recruiting data to make decisions and improve outcomes.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfortable working in an environment that values ownership, speed, ambiguity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency with recruiting systems and tools such as Workday, Gem, and LinkedIn
* Proven expertise with AI tools to create dashboard and automate recruiting processes.

**Additional Information:**

* This is a hybrid role, 3 days work from office
* Working hours are 2 pm to 11 pm IST
* Candidates currently based in Bangalore will be considered

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

description:

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together
  
  
**SUMMARY:**
The Talent Acquisition & Strategy Manager will lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategy and delivery for hiring in India, while providing strategic oversight of the India-based recruiting team that supports hiring across North America, Europe, and other international markets. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IT recruitment, stakeholder management, and building high-performing recruitment teams. This individual will drive hiring strategy for India and manage the capacity, resources, priorities, and performance of the India-based recruiting team supporting international hiring needs.
  
  
**PRIMARY DUTIES:**
Strategic Talent Acquisition Manager shall be responsible for but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategy and delivery for hiring across India, ensuring alignment with business growth and workforce requirements.

* Work closely with external partners, recruitment agencies, and sourcing vendors when required.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Demonstrated experience leading recruitment in India, with experience supporting or managing recruiting delivery for international markets preferred.
* Excellent understanding of recruitment practices, sourcing strategies, and talent market trends, with knowledge of international recruiting practices preferred.
* Proven experience managing recruitment teams and engaging with senior stakeholders.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION:**
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM is preferred.
  
  
LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand, and interpret job-related documents, instructions, policies, and communications in English. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners, as applicable to the position.

* Regularly spend long hours sitting and using office equipment and computers
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on expertise with Greenhouse (GH ATS), including requisition management, interview workflows, reporting, scorecards, and recruitment analytics.

Remote
