title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About the job**

We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief —
**“Every Day is Game Day.”**

We bring our best selves to work each day to realise our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services.

**Role Overview**

* We are looking for a proactive and organized Talent Acquisition Intern to support our non-technical hiring team.
* The intern will work closely with the Talent Acquisition Partner and support the day-to-day recruitment process, including interview coordination, candidate follow-ups, documentation, recruitment trackers and post-offer engagement.
* The role may also provide an opportunity to independently manage selected entry-level positions, smaller hiring cohorts or specific business requirements.
* In addition, the intern will contribute to projects related to recruitment automation, data analytics or employer branding, based on their skills and interests.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment Coordination and Candidate Management**

* Coordinate interviews between candidates, hiring managers and interview panels.
* Manage interview confirmations, reminders, rescheduling and candidate follow-ups.
* Follow up with interviewers for timely feedback and next steps.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment trackers and hiring reports.
* Support offer documentation, candidate documentation and onboarding coordination.
* Engage with offered candidates and maintain regular communication until joining.
* Highlight candidate concerns, delays or potential joining risks to the TA Partner.

**Recruitment Support**

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate discussions for assigned roles.
* Support the TA Partner in managing hiring requirements across different business teams.
* Independently handle selected entry-level roles or smaller hiring requirements.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and candidate expectations.

**TA Projects and Process Improvement**

Depending on the candidate’s skills and interests, the intern may also support:

* Recruitment automation using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Power Automate or similar platforms.
* Creation of recruitment trackers, reports or dashboards using Excel, Power BI or related tools.
* Improvement of recruitment templates, candidate communication and hiring processes.
* Creation of hiring-related content for LinkedIn, Instagram and other digital platforms.
* Employer-branding campaigns, hiring announcements and recruitment communication.

**About You**

* Interested in building a career in Talent Acquisition or recruitment.
* Strong communicator with a professional and candidate-friendly approach.
* Highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable following up with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Able to manage multiple interviews, candidates and activities simultaneously.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace tools.
* Willing to learn, take ownership and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Exposure to any one of the following areas will be an added advantage:**

* ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools
* Power BI, Power Automate or advanced Excel
* Canva or other content-creation tools
* LinkedIn, Instagram or employer-branding content
* Recruitment dashboards, reporting or data analysis

Expertise across all these areas is not required. We are looking for someone who brings strength or genuine hands-on interest in at least one area.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Real-world experience in recruitment and candidate management.
* Hands-on exposure to interview coordination, sourcing and hiring operations.
* Opportunity to manage selected roles or smaller hiring requirements.
* Exposure to recruitment automation, analytics and employer branding.
* Insight into hiring processes within a fast-paced FinTech organisation.
* Mentorship from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals.
* Opportunity to work on meaningful TA projects and process improvements.
* Possibility of a full-time opportunity based on performance and business requirements.

**What we Value in Our people**

* You take the shot: You Decide Fast and You Deliver Right
* You are the CEO of what you do: you show ownership and make things happen
* You own tomorrow: by building solutions for the merchants and doing the right thing
* You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do

title: Associate Director
description:
**About Taggd**

Taggd is a digital recruitment platform that provides Ready-to-Hire talent to India Inc. Combining human knowledge and data, we have fulfilled talent mandates for 100+ clients and ensured hiring manager success for half a million jobs across 14+ sectors. Our vision is to fulfil 1 million jobs through our talent platform by 2030.

**Role Snapshot**

* **Designation:**
  Associate Director – Talent Solutions
* **Location:**
  Bangalore
* **Industry Focus:**
  Manufacturing / Automobile
* **Reports to:**
  Senior Director – Talent Solutions
* **Team Span:**
  30+ recruiters
* **Hiring Volume:**
  1,000–1,500 hires annually across multiple business functions
* **Experience:**
  13+ years in recruitment or RPO, including 6–8 years leading a team

**About the Role**

Own the end-to-end talent acquisition mandate for an assigned manufacturing or automotive account. You will deliver the annual hiring plan to SLA, protect account revenue, and build a recruitment team that consistently meets its targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and Operations*

* Deliver the annual hiring plan of 1,000–1,500 hires, tracked as monthly fulfilment against plan (target: 95%+)
* Keep time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every requisition ageing beyond 30 days in the weekly account review
* Track funnel ratios weekly (CV-to-shortlist, shortlist-to-interview, interview-to-offer) and act on any stage below benchmark
* Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement
* Publish a weekly dashboard covering open positions, ageing, pipeline health, SLA status and offers in hand
* Own account revenue against the annual plan, including billing accuracy and on-time collections
* Ensure 100% ATS data accuracy with same-day candidate status updates

*Sourcing and Talent Pipeline*

* Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates and head-hunt for roles portals cannot fill
* Build ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles
* Introduce at least one new sourcing channel or campaign format each quarter and report its yield
* Complete skill and sub-skill mapping for 100% of active requisitions

*Client and Stakeholder Governance*

* Run weekly requisition reviews with hiring managers and monthly and quarterly business reviews with client leadership
* Act as the single point of contact for all recruitment, sourcing and escalation matters on the account
* Share market intelligence (talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement) in every monthly review
* Measure hiring manager CSAT each quarter and close every feedback item with a documented action

*Technology and AI Adoption*

* Drive full team adoption of AI-enabled tools for campaign creation, sourcing, screening and candidate engagement
* Ensure governance and compliance with zero audit exceptions on the account

*People Management*

* Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance through the year
* Share the quarterly scorecard with the Performance Management team on time
* Run structured engagement and team-bonding connects, and build a documented career path for each team member
* Plan and track training; hold voluntary attrition at or below 15%

**What We’re Looking For**

* 13+ years in recruitment or RPO delivery, of which 6–8 years leading a recruitment team through an annual hiring plan
* Volume hiring experience in manufacturing or automotive, with a clear view of where the talent sits, what it costs and why offers fall through (mandatory requirement)
* Ability to hold your own with business heads and CHRO-level stakeholders and challenge unrealistic briefs with data
* Hands-on sourcing skills: head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and professional networks
* Strong funnel analysis: spot a failing stage early, explain the cause and act on it
* Comfort with AI-enabled sourcing tools (CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated outreach) and measuring what each one yields
* Ability to run the weekly delivery dashboard and monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show
* Skill in building recruiter capability: identify gaps, coach and add capability where needed
* Ownership of the measures the client judges the account on: hiring plan fulfilment, TAT and SLA management
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**Description:**

Talent Solutions RPO is seeking an experienced
**Technology Recruiter**
to lead end-to-end talent acquisition initiatives for a portfolio of technology roles. This position plays a critical role in partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to identify, attract, and hire top technical talent in a highly competitive market.

The successful candidate will combine deep recruiting expertise, market intelligence, and strong stakeholder management skills to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes. This role requires a proactive talent advisor who can influence hiring decisions, develop innovative sourcing strategies, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience while driving recruitment excellence across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Technology Recruiter, you will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle while serving as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders. Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with hiring managers and leadership teams to develop effective hiring strategies aligned with business objectives and workforce planning needs.
* Drive end-to-end recruitment activities, including talent sourcing, candidate identification, screening, assessment, interview management, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for current and future technology hiring requirements across multiple skill domains.
* Utilize market insights, competitive intelligence, and talent mapping techniques to identify and engage high-caliber technical talent.
* Provide consultative guidance to hiring managers on talent availability, compensation trends, interview best practices, and hiring decisions.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through consistent communication, timely feedback, and a professional recruitment process.
* Leverage data, recruiting metrics, and reporting to drive process improvements and influence hiring outcomes.
* Collaborate with Human Resources, Talent Partners, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Champion diversity and inclusion initiatives by developing inclusive sourcing strategies and diverse candidate pipelines.
* Support employer branding efforts and promote the organization's value proposition to attract top-tier technology professionals.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, processes, and applicable employment regulations throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and become a trusted talent advisor capable of influencing and driving hiring success.

**Required Skills:**

• 8+ years Proven success in full cycle recruitment utilizing mature account management skills.

• Experience and comfort partnering & consulting at all levels of leadership.

• Desire and capability to work with other Talent Partners to drive recruitment solutions across a wide variety of openings.

• Possess an ability to be flexible and provide the right solution at the right time.

• Success in developing inclusive pipelines.

• Success in guiding, consulting and educating hiring managers on hiring best practices.

• Experience in guiding managers on use of corporate services such as relocation and immigration.

• Stay informed and connected to external factors and market conditions that impact our ability to attract quality hires.

• Develop knowledge and understanding of the culture, products and industry - Support internal processes/requirements.

• Bachelor’s or equivalent experience, Masters in HR/OD or MBA is a plus.

• This role will support and grow the Product Engineering function. 5+ years of technical recruiting experience in a similar environment is required Qualifications.

• Creating opportunities to influence external Product Engineering talent for long range hiring goals

• Influencing hiring decisions based on recruiting expertise and shared business goals

• Provide hiring insights through metrics and analysis reporting to business and TA leaders

• Develop and drive recruiting strategy for product engineering across business units

• Develop and drive an assessment strategy with each hiring manager

• Lead the offer process and provide guidance to the hiring leader & HR Business Partner to arrive at competitive and equitable compensation packages

• Understanding business needs and leverage the business strategy in your communication efforts and recruiting strategy to win talent

• Collaborate, partner across teams and mentor junior recruiters.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist - Bengaluru, IND
description:
**About Diversified**
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
  
  
**What To Expect**
At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Senior Talent Acquisition Partner**
Bengaluru (Bangalore), India | Global Talent Acquisition
  
  
**Shift Timing – 5 PM - 2 AM IST**
**Overview Of Position**
The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for sourcing, engaging, and supporting the hiring of qualified talent across Diversified’s global regions, with an initial focus on India and the United States. Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the Talent Acquisition Lead, this position combines proactive sourcing with candidate screening, interview coordination, and offer preparation to support a consistent and responsive recruitment process.
  
  
The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner uses various sourcing tools, the applicant tracking system (ATS), and other recruiting channels to identify active and passive candidates. This person builds relationships with qualified talent, including candidates for whom a suitable opening is not currently available, and maintains engagement for future opportunities. Success requires 5–7 years of sourcing experience, excellent spoken and written English, strong follow-through, and the ability to deliver a positive candidate and hiring manager experience across cultures and time zones.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Execute sourcing and recruitment activities across global regions, initially prioritizing India and the United States, in alignment with the Talent Acquisition Lead’s direction and established global processes.
* Partner with hiring managers, HRBPs, and the Talent Acquisition Lead to understand role requirements, hiring priorities, and the skills and experience needed for success.
* Use talent searches, professional networks, referrals, and targeted outreach to identify qualified active and passive candidates.
* Build targeted searches and talent maps, tailor outreach to candidate interests, and assess sourcing results to refine strategies for difficult-to-fill roles.
* Conduct initial candidate conversations to assess relevant experience, interest, availability, and alignment with role requirements; share clear candidate summaries with hiring teams.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs, keeping in touch with qualified candidates when no suitable position is available through personalized updates and periodic check-ins.
* Maintain accurate records of candidate skills, interests, availability, and prior discussions in the ATS so qualified talent can be re-engaged when appropriate opportunities arise.
* Coordinate interviews across regions and time zones, provide clear instructions and timely updates, and follow up with interviewers to obtain feedback and support next steps.
* Prepare offer letters and related documentation using approved templates and terms, coordinate required approvals, and support timely offer communication and candidate follow-up.
* Coordinate with HR Operations and regional HR teams on pre-employment requirements and the handoff to onboarding after offer acceptance.
* Deliver a professional, respectful experience for internal and external candidates, including timely communication and appropriate closure for candidates who are not selected.
* Keep requisition and candidate records current in the ATS, including sourcing activity, interview progress, feedback, offer status, and disposition reasons.
* Track sourcing effectiveness, outreach response, qualified candidate conversion, interview progression, offer acceptance, and pipeline engagement; share findings and improvement ideas with the Talent Acquisition Lead.
* Use AI tools with human review to validate sourcing results and communication quality, and handle candidate information confidentially in line with company policies and regional requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant recruiting experience will be considered.
* Experience: 5–7 years of hands-on sourcing experience with demonstrated success identifying, engaging, and converting qualified active and passive candidates.
* Global Recruiting Experience: Experience supporting recruitment in India and the United States, with the ability to adapt sourcing and candidate communication to regional markets and hiring practices. Experience supporting additional global regions preferred.
* Sourcing and Systems: Practical experience using AI-enabled sourcing tools, enterprise ATS platforms, Boolean search, talent mapping, professional networks, and personalized candidate outreach. Dayforce ATS experience preferred.
* Recruitment Coordination: Experience scheduling interviews across time zones, gathering feedback, preparing offer documentation, coordinating approvals, and supporting a smooth handoff to onboarding.
* Talent Pipeline Development: Demonstrated ability to build relationships with qualified candidates and maintain engagement over time, including when an immediate opportunity is unavailable.
* English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential for candidate conversations, outreach, interview instructions, offer communications, and collaboration with US and global stakeholders.
* Skills and Competencies: Strong relationship-building, organization, attention to detail, judgment, and follow-through; able to balance multiple requisitions, work independently within agreed processes, and apply feedback.
* Data and Reporting: Ability to use ATS reporting and Excel to track sourcing activity, candidate progression, and pipeline effectiveness and recommend practical improvements.
* Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Experience sourcing technology, engineering, project delivery, or field service talent preferred.

**Key Succes Metrics**

* Consistently delivers qualified candidate pipelines and slates aligned with role requirements and agreed hiring priorities.
* Improves outreach response, qualified candidate conversion, and sourcing effectiveness through targeted searches and appropriate use of AI and ATS tools.
* Maintains engaged talent pipelines and successfully re-engages qualified candidates for future openings.
* Coordinates interviews and offer preparation accurately and within agreed timelines, reducing avoidable delays.
* Maintains complete, accurate, and timely ATS records that support reliable reporting and candidate follow-up.
* Delivers positive candidate and hiring manager feedback and supports strong interview progression and offer acceptance.

Work Classification - Hybrid
  
  
**What We Offer**
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
  
  
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR.

Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes.

* English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes.
* Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred.
* Skills and Competencies: Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change.
* Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Experience building or scaling global recruitment operations or shared services preferred.

**Key Success Metrics**

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Finance, and Interview Coordination to ensure smooth, timely hiring decisions.
* Be an ambassador for Everpure

**What You’ll Need To Bring To This Role…**

* Strong Recruiting expertise with a focus on quality, speed, and partnership.
* Ability to influence and guide business leaders through the recruiting lifecycle.
* Proven success sourcing and closing passive talent in a competitive market.
* Experience hiring for sales roles.
* Solid ability to assess candidate fit beyond resumes.
* Comfort building relationships via phone, video, and in-person interactions.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing hiring decisions.
* Strong direct sourcing skills and structured interviewing capability.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
Everpure is primarily an
**in-office environment.**
This role is based in Bangalore, and you’ll be expected to work from the office in line with company policy, except during PTO, business travel, or other approved leave.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
  
  
**Accommodations And Accessibility**
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
  
  
**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
  
  
Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
  
  
**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description**

Mercom India, a subsidiary of U.S.-based Mercom Capital Group, is a leading clean energy communications and consulting firm with expertise in renewable energy. Based in Bengaluru, Mercom India supports the Indian clean energy market through research, news, and communication services. Known for its leadership and impact, Mercom India actively helps shape India’s rapidly evolving clean energy sector. The company is dedicated to advancing sustainable and renewable energy initiatives across India.

Mercom is seeking an experienced Human Resources Manager with a proven ability to lead HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, and organizational development. The ideal candidate will be proactive, strategic, and able to support a fast-paced media, research and events environment

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role located in Bengaluru for a Human Resources Generalist. The HR Generalist will be responsible for overseeing daily HR operations, including the administration of HR policies, employee benefits, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement programs, and supporting various HR functions to enhance workplace culture and productivity.

**1. HR Operations and Compliance**

* Maintain accurate HR documentation, employee records, statutory compliance, and audit readiness.
* Ensure company policies are consistently applied across all teams.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of Indian labor laws, wage standards, and regulatory changes.

·       Oversee payroll coordination, leave management, and attendance systems with high accuracy.

**2. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Excellence**

* Manage complete lifecycle recruitment for open positions.
* Drive talent sourcing through job portals, ATS, LinkedIn, internal databases, employee referrals, and strategic networking.
* Conduct structured screening, competency-based interviewing, and salary negotiations.
* Build an annual hiring roadmap aligned with business growth.
* Create standardized interview frameworks and evaluation templates to ensure fair and consistent hiring.

**3. Employee Onboarding and Orientation**

* Develop a structured onboarding program with clear role expectations, culture orientation, and 30-60-90-365 day plans.
* Ensure new hires have seamless integration into teams and company processes.

**4. Performance Management and Goal Setting**

* Implement quarterly and yearly performance review cycles.
* Partner with department heads to define KPIs, OKRs, and measurable performance goals.
* Conduct coaching sessions with managers to improve evaluation quality.
* Support the development of high-performance talent pipelines.

**5. Learning and Development**

* Conduct training needs analysis and implement learning programs that support skill development across editorial, research, events, and business teams.
* Organize internal workshops, leadership training, communication skills programs, and technical upskilling.
* Track training effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.

**6. Culture Building and Employee Engagement**

* Build a culture of trust, accountability, and openness.
* Plan structured engagement activities that support collaboration, wellness, and morale.
* Develop employee feedback systems and action plans based on insights.
* Establish mechanisms to identify early indicators of conflict, burnout, or policy deviations.

**7. HR Policy Development and Governance**

* Create and update HR policies, organizational handbooks, disciplinary guidelines, and workplace behavior frameworks.
* Ensure zero tolerance for any form of misconduct and maintain a safe, respectful working environment.
* Support leadership in communication of policies and organizational expectations.

**8. Disciplinary Action and Workplace Management**

* Handle employee relations issues, grievances, and investigations with discretion and professionalism.
* Conduct fact-based disciplinary meetings aligned with company guidelines.
* Ensure timely resolution through structured processes and documented follow-ups.

**9. Strategic HR and Leadership Support**

* Work closely with senior leadership to align HR priorities with business objectives.
* Provide data driven insights, HR metrics, and reports on hiring, retention, attrition, and performance.
* Contribute to organizational design, workforce planning, and future capability building.

**10. Exit Management**

* Conduct exit interviews, analyze patterns, and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure smooth offboarding, full and final settlement coordination, and knowledge transfer.

**Experience**

Minimum 2 years to 8 years of proven HR experience.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge and experience in core Human Resources (HR) functions, including recruitment, employee relations, and managing workplace culture.
* Proficiency in HR Management practices, with the ability to implement and oversee HR Policies effectively.
* Experience with Employee Benefits administration and a strong understanding of Benefits Administration processes.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and take proactive initiatives independently.
* MBA in HR,
  Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, or equivalent
* Experience in a mid-sized organization and familiarity with employment laws, particularly within the Indian market, is a plus.

title: HR & Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Overview**

We are looking for an HR & Talent Acquisition Intern to support Ecolibrium's hiring and day-to-day HR administrationfor 3 months. You will keep recruitment moving until our new Talent Acquisition Specialist joins. You will screen CVs, book interviews, keep candidates informed and handle core HR admin. All hiring decisions, offers. and approvals stay with the Head of HR/People and department heads. You will work from clear criteria and templates, with a named person to check in with daily.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. It suits someone organised, warm with people and keen to start a career in HR.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment support**

• Screen incoming CVs against role requirements using an agreed checklist, and shortlist for hiring manager review.

• Run short initial phone screens to confirm availability, notice period, salary expectations and basic fit.

• Schedule interviews with candidates, hiring managers and panel members, and send calendar invites and joining details.

• Follow up with interviewers for feedback within agreed timelines and flag delays.

• Send interview confirmations, reminders and regret emails using approved templates.

• Post job ads on job portals, LinkedIn and the careers page as directed.

• Keep the ATS or recruitment tracker accurate and up to date for every candidate and role.

• Prepare a simple weekly hiring status update for the Head of HR/People.
**HR administration**

• Collect and check pre-joining documents for new hires.

• Support onboarding: welcome emails, induction scheduling and first-day logistics.

• Maintain employee records and HR files, digital and physical.

• Answer basic employee queries and route others to the right person.

• Help with HR trackers, letters and other admin tasks as needed.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

• Pursuing or recently completed an MBA/PGDM in HR, a BBA, or a related degree.

• Available full-time for 3 months, starting immediately.

• Clear, professional written and spoken English.

• Strong organisation and follow-through: you can juggle many candidates and deadlines without dropping any.

• Comfortable with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, especially Excel/Sheets and calendar tools.

• A warm, approachable manner with candidates and colleagues.

• Discretion with confidential candidate and employee information.

**Desirable**

• A previous HR or recruitment internship.

• Exposure to an ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter or job portals such as Naukri.

• Interest in technology or engineering hiring.

• Kannada or Hindi in addition to English.

**WHY JOIN US**

**What You'll Gain**

• Hands-on experience across the full recruitment cycle in a growing technology company.

• Practical HR operations experience: onboarding, records and employee support.

• Regular guidance and feedback from the HR team.

• An internship certificate and a reference based on your performance.

• Possibility of extension or a full-time role, subject to performance and business need.

title: Senior Vendor Management Analyst
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Workforce Platform Operations**

* Support day-to-day operation of Delta's contingent workforce management platform and associated supplier ecosystem.
* Monitor workforce requisition flow from request creation through fulfillment and onboarding.
* Identify bottlenecks, aging requests, approval delays, and process breakdowns.
* Partner with workforce suppliers and managed service providers to resolve operational issues.
* Maintain program documentation, workflows, operating procedures, governance artifacts, and reporting standards.
* Help ensure workforce data quality and reporting accuracy.

**Requisition & Workforce Lifecycle Management**

* Track contractor requisitions, candidate submissions, interviews, selections, onboarding, extensions, renewals, and offboarding activities.
* Analyze requisition cycle times and identify opportunities to improve speed-to-fill and hiring efficiency.
* Monitor hiring demand and workforce trends across technology organizations.
* Coordinate with hiring managers, global delivery teams, procurement organizations, and workforce suppliers to resolve workforce-related issues.
* Support workforce planning initiatives and contractor utilization reporting.

**Statement of Work (SOW) Governance**

* Support intake, tracking, and governance of professional services and outcome-based service engagements.
* Monitor SOW milestones, expirations, amendments, renewals, and completion activities.
* Track supplier commitments, performance metrics, and delivery obligations.
* Maintain reporting on active SOWs and associated spend.
* Ensure leadership has visibility into upcoming actions, risks, milestones, and renewal requirements.

**Supplier Performance & Program Governance**

* Monitor supplier performance against defined workforce program metrics.
* Support quarterly supplier reviews, performance discussions, and operational governance meetings.
* Develop dashboards and scorecards measuring fulfillment quality, cycle times, response times, supplier effectiveness, and workforce performance.
* Track supplier action items and follow-up activities through completion.
* Assist with supplier performance improvement initiatives and operational optimization efforts.
* Review contractor and SOW engagements against worker classification criteria (behavioral control, financial control, relationship factors) to identify misclassification risk, particularly when SOW engagements begin to resemble staff augmentation in practice.

**Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop reporting and analytics related to workforce demand, fulfillment performance, requisition aging, contractor population trends, supplier performance, and overall program health.
* Create executive-ready presentations and operating review materials.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, and increase program efficiency.
* Support implementation of new capabilities, workflows, reporting enhancements, and process improvements.
* Partner with stakeholders to improve overall workforce program performance and user experience.
* Monitor contractor tenure, supervision patterns, and integration into Delta's day-to-day operations to ensure engagements stay within defined co-employment risk boundaries; flag and escalate cases where a contractor's role or reporting structure drifts toward employee-like status.
* Partner with IT security and identity management teams to ensure contractor onboarding triggers timely, role-appropriate system access provisioning, and that offboarding triggers prompt de-provisioning; maintain audit-ready records of access grants tied to active engagement status.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in workforce operations, managed services programs, vendor management, contingent labor management, staffing operations, procurement operations, PMO functions, or business operations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel skills including data analysis, reporting, forecasting, and trend identification.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
* Experience working with AgileOne workforce management, vendor managementsystems or similar Beeline, Fieldglass, Magnit, Workday VMS etc)
* Experience supporting large-scale contingent workforce programs, managed service providers, staffing operations, or workforce governance organizations.
* Familiarity with contractor requisition workflows, workforce planning processes, and supplier management practices.
* Experience working with Statement of Work (SOW) governance and professional services engagements.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Strong PowerPoint and executive communication skills.
* Experience working within structured, process-driven operational environments.
* Experience developing dashboards using Power BI or similar analytics platforms.
* Knowledge of supplier governance, workforce analytics, and operational performance management.
* Experience supporting globally distributed technology organizations and offshore delivery models.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager - Human Resources
description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
  
  
**Group Summary**
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Role Purpose**
The HR Manager is responsible for leading and aligning HR operations and people practices across the shared service groups at the MICB campus, in close collaboration with Group HR Business Leads. The role owns the consistent execution of HR policies and processes across the campus, with accountability for HR operations and governance, payroll and HR systems, compensation and benefits, talent acquisition, learning and development, and employee relations, ensuring alignment with Magna standards and Indian legal requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* HR Operations & Policy Governance
* Drive standardization and consistent implementation of HR processes, policies, and practices across all shared service groups.
* Ensure alignment with global Magna guidelines and local legal and business requirements.
* Payroll & HR Systems
* Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant end-to-end payroll across all groups at the campus.
* Own HR data quality and effective use of Workday, ensuring it serves as the single source of truth, particularly for compensation and employee data.
* Partner with payroll vendors, Finance, and HR stakeholders, and use HR data and reporting to support business decisions.
* Compensation & Benefits
* Lead compensation programs, including salary administration, annual reviews, market benchmarking, and implementation of compensation policies.
* Drive a harmonized benefits approach across India, balancing consistency with local market and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure competitive and equitable total rewards and effective management of employee benefits.
* Talent Acquisition & Recruitment
* Lead talent acquisition and recruitment for the shared services organization, partnering with hiring managers on workforce needs and sourcing strategies.
* Ensure an effective candidate experience, talent pipeline, and employer branding approach.
* Learning & Development
* Identify capability and training needs and coordinate targeted development solutions for employees and leaders.
* Monitor effectiveness and promote continuous learning and capability development.
* Employee Relations
* Advise managers and employees on HR and employee relations matters and ensure concerns are addressed consistently and in line with company policies.
* Foster a positive and inclusive employee experience across the campus.

**Key Competencies**

* HR Operations & Execution Excellence: Translates policies and standards into consistent and effective HR processes.
* Compensation, Payroll & HR Systems Expertise: Demonstrates practical expertise in compensation and benefits, payroll governance, Workday/HRIS, and HR data integrity.
* Stakeholder Management & Influencing: Works effectively across business groups, leaders, HR teams, Finance, and external partners, including without direct authority.
* Problem Solving & Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyses HR issues, uses data to identify root causes, and implements practical solutions.
* Communication & Change Leadership: Communicates clearly, influences stakeholders, and leads harmonization and organizational change.
* People Leadership & Employee Relations: Handles sensitive employee matters, advises leaders, develops capability, and supports a positive employee environment.

**Success Measures**

* Consistent HR policies, processes, and service standards across the campus.
* Accurate, timely payroll and reliable Workday/HR data.
* Harmonized and competitive compensation and benefits practices.
* Effective talent acquisition and capability development.
* Strong employee experience and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Overall Accountability**
Own the consistent delivery and governance of HR services across the MICB campus, while partnering with Group HR Business Leads and other stakeholders to ensure effective local execution.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* 8-12 years of progressive HR experience, ideally with exposure to shared services or comparable multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong hands-on experience across HR operations, payroll, HR systems/Workday, compensation and benefits, talent acquisition, and employee relations.
* Sound knowledge of Indian labour law and HR compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience operating across multiple business or stakeholder groups.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
  
  
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

Regular / Permanent
  
  
**Group**
Magna Corporate

description:
**Role:** 
 Talent Acquisition Associate
 



**Start Date:** 
 October 2026
 



**Location:** 
 Onsite in HSR, Bangalore
 



  





**About KAVI** 




 Professional investors need to understand businesses before they back them — and the best way to do that is to talk to people who've actually built and run them. That's what we do. We connect investors with industry experts, then turn those conversations into a searchable library covering business models, competitive dynamics, and market trends.
 



  





 Over 100 investment firms, managing more than USD 100 billion in assets, rely on what we publish.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We know exactly who we want on this team. Until now, we've been finding them the way small companies do: late, and only when something breaks. You're here to change that.
 



  





 You'll own hiring end to end: finding the people, running the process, and closing the ones we want. You'll be the first person a candidate speaks to, and the bridge between them and the rest of the team. Along the way you'll also handle the smaller people things that come with a growing company — onboarding, paperwork, the occasional "who do I ask about this?"
 



  





 This is an entry\-level role. The process, the tools, the way we work — all of that we'll teach you. What we can't teach is judgement about people: reading a CV and knowing what it isn't saying, sensing within 5 minutes of a call whether someone is sharp or just polished, telling the difference between nervous and unprepared. That's the part you need to bring.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Run hiring from start to finish: source candidates, screen, schedule, interview, and make offers
* Be the candidate's guide through the process — clear, quick, and honest at every step
* Build and maintain a pipeline so we're never starting from zero when a role opens
* Handle onboarding and the basic HR admin that keeps a small team running smoothly



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A degree in any discipline — psychology, business, or HR is a plus, but curiosity matters more
* 0–2 years of experience; internships in recruiting, campus placement, or people\-facing roles all count
* A genuine read on people: you notice things in conversation that others miss
* Organised enough to run several searches at once without letting a candidate fall through the cracks

**About Atomgrid** 




  






 Atomgrid is building the next\-generation specialty chemicals company — from India, for the world. 
 




  






 Today we operate in more than 10 countries, with a global team of 100\+ people and sales presence across key global markets. 
 





 Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and backed by two rounds of institutional capital, we're driven by one large ambition: to redefine what "Made in India" means in specialty chemicals.
 




  






 Recent Coverage :
 




  






 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/news\-inc42\-funding\-share\-7417098107236134912\-Jj\_u/
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 The Lead – People \& Culture will be Atomgrid’s first people person and will play a foundational role in shaping our people function. The individual will set up HR policies, performance management frameworks, employee engagement practices, and ensure compliance with labour laws and regulations. The role will also focus on talent acquisition ensuring that we hire the best talent across R\&D, manufacturing, supply chain, and business teams. This is a rare 0 → 1 role with direct impact on Atomgrid’s growth and culture.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**​​1\. People \& Culture** 



* Build and define Atomgrid’s culture from the ground up.
* Act as the cultural ambassador across teams.



  






 2\.
 
**Talent Acquisition \& Employer Branding** 



* Lead end\-to\-end hiring across business, R\&D, operations and manufacturing roles with speed and quality.
* Build a strong talent pipeline through direct sourcing, networks, and partnerships.
* Design and implement structured hiring processes, assessment frameworks, and strong candidate experience.
* Partner with founders and BU heads to close senior/critical roles within aggressive timelines.
* Build Atomgrid’s employer brand in chemicals and manufacturing talent markets.



  





**2\. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Set up HR policies. Implement and run the HRMS system ( Keka )
* Ensure compliance with POSH, Factories Act, and labour laws and other such policies
* Establish performance management and review cycles.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 5–8 years of HR / people / culture  experience, ideally in a startup / growth\-stage company.
* Proven success in high\-volume and leadership hiring.
* Strong foundation as an HR generalist.
* Exposure to manufacturing / chemicals / pharma sectors is a plus.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity, set up processes from scratch, and scale them.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, high empathy, and a business\-first mindset.



  





**Why join us ?** 



* Create real impact by building Atomgrid’s people function from the ground up and making hiring a core strategic driver of growth.
* A chance to join a well\-funded company in its early stages, providing you a high growth and learning environment.
* Work with a team of highly passionate and hungry individuals who want to leave a lasting impact on the speciality chemicals industry.
* Competitive salary \+ attractive ESOPs, high ownership sharing in our growth and success.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 AchieversIT Academy offers training and career development opportunities for both freshers and experienced professionals across multiple companies and domains. The academy focuses on helping learners build practical skills that enhance their employability and long\-term career growth. By partnering with a range of hiring organizations, AchieversIT Academy connects learners with relevant job openings and placement support. The team is committed to creating a supportive learning and placement environment where individuals can progress in line with industry needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Placement Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for coordinating placements for learners, including building and maintaining strong relationships with hiring partners and corporate clients. Day\-to\-day activities include identifying suitable job opportunities, matching candidates to roles, organizing interviews, and tracking placement outcomes. The Placement Manager will collaborate with trainers and academic staff to understand learner profiles, conduct pre\-placement sessions, and provide guidance on resumes, interviews, and career planning. The role also involves maintaining placement records, preparing reports, and continuously improving placement processes to achieve higher success rates.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to interact effectively with hiring partners and corporate clients.
* Experience in placement coordination, recruitment, or talent acquisition, including sourcing, screening, and shortlisting candidates.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to support learners in resume building, interview preparation, and career guidance.
* Organizational and planning skills to manage multiple placement activities, track outcomes, and maintain accurate records and reports.
* Ability to work collaboratively with trainers, academic staff, and operations teams to align placement activities with course outcomes.
* Comfort with using MS Office tools, applicant tracking systems, or basic HR/recruitment platforms for data management and reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; prior experience in an educational institution, training academy, or HR/recruitment firm is an advantage.
* Proactive, learner\-focused mindset with a commitment to equal opportunity and inclusive placement practices.

The

 Identify opportunities to streamline processes using the university’s Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) like PeopleSoft or Banner.

 Use data\-driven metrics to report on workforce trends, retention rates, and institutional turnover patterns to support leadership decisions

* **Education: Bachelor’s degree** 
 in Human Resources, Business Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a closely related field.

 Professional HR credentials such as
 **SHRM\-CP/SHRM\-SCP** 
 or

 .



  





**Core Competencies** 




  




* Thorough knowledge of employment laws and federal compliance issues unique to educational systems.
* Exceptional conflict resolution, communication, and diplomatic skills to interact across various levels of academia.

title: Manager - People Operations & Administration
description:
About the role
   

  

 You’ll own the day\-to\-day People Operations and Administration backbone of Kirana Club — including payroll inputs, leaves, reimbursements, employee onboarding, office operations, vendors, assets, and company documentation.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on execution role for someone who is organised, resourceful, and dependable. We’re looking for someone who can take an operational problem, figure out what needs to happen, coordinate across people and vendors, and close it without constant follow\-up.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 • Own employee operations, including onboarding/offboarding, leaves, payroll changes, reimbursements, and employee documentation.
   

  

 • Run office administration and vendor management, including facilities, procurement, repairs, supplies, and other day\-to\-day requirements.
   

  

 • Own company asset management, including laptop procurement, allocation, repairs, inventory, and recovery.
   

  

 • Maintain important company, employee, vendor, and compliance documentation, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
   

  

 • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, banks, CA/CS, and external vendors for documentation, filings, KYC, signatures, and other operational requirements.
   

  

 • Support the founders with meeting scheduling, documentation, and coordination when required.
   

  

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 • 4–7 years of experience across People Ops, HR Ops, Administration, or Business Operations, preferably in a startup environment.
   

  

 • Strong ownership and follow\-through — you don’t stop at “the vendor hasn’t responded.”
   

  

 • Street\-smart and resourceful, with the ability to figure things out without a detailed playbook.
   

  

 • Highly organised and diligent, with strong attention to detail.
   

  

 • Good communication and coordination skills, and comfort working across employees, founders, and external partners.
   

  

 • High integrity and discretion when handling confidential employee and company information.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT):** 




  





 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
 



  





 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Strategic Business Partnering
 



 • Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
 



 • Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
 



 • Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.
 



  





 2\. Talent \& Capability Development
 



 • Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
 



 • Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
 



 • Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
 



 • Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
 



  





 3\. Performance \& Rewards
 



 • Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
 



 • Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
 



 • Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
 



 • Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
 



  





 4\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 • Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
 



 • Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
 



 • Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
 



 • Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.
 



  





 5\. HR Operations, Payroll \& Compliance
 



 • Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
 



 • Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
 



 • Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
 



 • Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
 



  





 6\. Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
 



 • Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
 



 • Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
 



 • Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.
 



  





**Skills \& Attributes** 




  





 • Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
 



 • Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
 



 • Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
 



 • High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
 



 • Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
 



 • Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 




  





 • Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
 



 • 8–10 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 5 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
 



 • Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families.  Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
